Use case: stylized-concept / production animated RPG equipment cutout atlas. Use the supplied original fantasy fashion images ONLY as references for rich material rendering, craftsmanship, natural cloth folds and bright sophisticated colors. Create NEW distinct original designs described below, not copies of the reference garments and not flat SVG-like icons.
High quality painterly-realistic luminous 3D clothing with tactile woven cloth, fine seams, satin lining, embroidered borders, dimensional polished metal and translucent gems. True alpha transparency, no opaque backdrop, no checkerboard paint, no cast shadow, no floor, no text, labels, grid lines, numbers, logos or watermark. Only the requested disconnected apparel parts; absolutely no people, faces, hair, skin, hands, torso bodies, mannequins, hangers or stands. Invisible wearer.
Every part must be COMPLETE and UNCROPPED inside its own cell, small enough to leave at least 12% transparent padding around it. Broad transparent lanes between rows and columns; none of the source rectangles may include a neighboring part. Please do NOT fill all available space with over-large objects.
Create a landscape SIX-column FOUR-row atlas, high resolution, 24 separate pieces exactly. Each row contains two triplets; a triplet is [sleeveless garment TORSO, detached anatomical LEFT SLEEVE, detached anatomical RIGHT SLEEVE]. The torso contains NO attached sleeves, only clean shoulder/armhole edges. Both sleeves are full shoulder-to-wrist lengths with complete elbow fabric and cuffs, neutral straight hanging shape with only a slight natural bend; do not include hands.
Row 1: design A FRONT torso/left sleeve/right sleeve, followed by design A BACK torso/left sleeve/right sleeve.
Row 2: design A TRUE RIGHT SIDE torso/left sleeve/right sleeve, followed by design A TRUE LEFT SIDE torso/left sleeve/right sleeve.
Row 3: design B FRONT torso/left sleeve/right sleeve, followed by design B BACK torso/left sleeve/right sleeve.
Row 4: design B TRUE RIGHT SIDE torso/left sleeve/right sleeve, followed by design B TRUE LEFT SIDE torso/left sleeve/right sleeve.
The wearer faces screen-right in right view and screen-left in left view. Each is a genuine separately authored view; back shows back yoke/seams, sides show profile, never paste the same frontal coat or mirror one side. Keep consistent design and material across all views. All torso pieces fit a person with two shoulders, one neck opening, tapered waist and natural hips, not oversized shapeless tents. Long designs retain their length; sleeves fit human arms.
Design A is 薄荷晨讀外套 / mint morning-reading jacket: a graceful pale mint-green tailored academy jacket to the upper hip, ivory satin facing, gently asymmetric layered lapels, small botanical gold buttons, embossed mint-leaf corner embroidery and subtle dew-green crystal stitch tabs; rich, light and scholarly. The shoulder seams are slim and fitted, cuff panels are cream and mint with gold thread.
Design B is 杉影觀察長衫 / cedar-observation long coat: a distinct deep cedar/forest green long scholarly tunic-coat to the knee with a standing collar, cocoa-brown trim, pale sage vertical inset panels, finely embroidered Taiwan-cedar branch silhouettes, copper botanical clasps and moss satin lining. Split front panels, tailored waist with light structured pleats, long elegant hem. It is a sleeved long coat with detached sleeve pieces for this atlas, NOT a cape or poncho.
